content.text:
The provider card pills now say when the env/config source has been overridden. Lint passes.

What changed in `apps/frontend/src/components/settings/llm-providers-section.tsx`:

- Cards for saved project configs now get their pills from a new `projectConfigBadges` helper. If the provider is also declared in `nao_config.yaml`, the pill reads `nao_config.yaml (overridden)` — always, since a saved project config takes full precedence over the file. If the provider comes from the environment, the pill reads `ENV (overridden)` only when the project config actually stores its own API key or credentials (i.e. `apiKeyPreview`/`credentialPreviews` are present); if the key was left empty, the env key is still in use, so the pill stays plain `ENV`.
- The card for a provider that exists only in `nao_config.yaml` (not yet overridden) keeps its plain `nao_config.yaml` pill, now hardcoded since the env case can't apply there (the backend already de-duplicates env providers against config providers).

`npm run lint` completes cleanly across backend, frontend, and shared.

I think I've worked through the main points and have a solid understanding of what needs to be done.
